qualitative.gate_3m_moat_note: Global commercial P&C and reinsurance underwriting scale combined with a decentralized, disciplined underwriting culture where manager incentives prioritize sub-95% combined ratios over premium volume. Generates >$39B in negative-cost float invested in fixed income and look-through equities. Demonstrated pricing power via aggressive commercial rate hardening exceeding loss-cost inflation. Primary erosion threats: catastrophic mega-disaster events (hurricanes/earthquakes), prolonged casualty soft market pricing cycles, and mark-to-market investment volatility.
qualitative.note: Passes all 6 gates under the float institution rubric. Global commercial P&C and reinsurance powerhouse led by Prem Watsa, generating durable negative-cost underwriting float (sub-95% combined ratio) compounded across high-yielding fixed income and look-through equities. Pricing power demonstrated across commercial rate hardening cycles. Fortress capital adequacy (Solvency II/LICAT >200%, 8.8x interest coverage) and exceptional 40-year track record of compounding book value per share at ~18.7% CAGR. [5-10Y g: commercial premium volume 4.0% + rate/pricing indexation 2.0% + float investment income 2.5% - catastrophe/loss cycle drag 1.0% + share repurchases 1.0%]
qualitative.evidence: Multi-cycle 5-year median ROIC/ROE exceeds 20% (operating ROIC 27.8%, 2025 GAAP ROIC 20.13%). Underwriting combined ratio of 92.7% (2024) and 93.0% (2025) generated >$1.8B in undiscounted annual underwriting profit, growing low-cost float to $39.3B. Investment portfolio of $60B+ yields strong recurring interest and dividend income in a normalized rate environment. Solvency II, LICAT, and RBC capital adequacy ratios across operating subsidiaries (Odyssey, Allied World, Crum & Forster, Northbridge) stand comfortably above 200%. Holding company liquidity exceeds $2B with consolidated EBIT/interest coverage of 8.8x ($7.26B EBIT vs $822M interest). Prem Watsa's decentralized 40-year stewardship has compounded book value per share at 18.7% CAGR.
